# Trizlink — Documentation Index

> Trizlink is a link-management platform: branded short links, bio pages, QR codes, and the click analytics
> that tie them together, inside workspaces several people can share. Sign-in is Google-only. Plans are Free,
> Pro ($6/month) and Team ($18/month), billed annually at two months free. Product: https://trizlink.com.
> Author: Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

## About

Trizlink turns long URLs into short links and gives each one a QR code plus click statistics broken down by
country, referrer, device and browser. Around that it offers bio pages, custom domains, workspaces with four
fixed roles, UTM templates, tracking pixels, webhooks, embeddable widgets, a social composer, and a public
HTTP API of 18 endpoints at https://api.trizlink.com/v1.

This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec — a structured index for large language
models. It is rewritten with the documentation it indexes, so a claim here is a claim on a page.

## What Trizlink does not do — stated because these are the questions most often asked wrongly

- **There is no browser extension**, for any browser, and none is planned.
- **Custom domains can be added and verified, but do not serve links yet.** That is waiting on infrastructure,
  not on the reader.
- **Social publishing is built but inert.** No post is published today; the switch that enables it fails
  closed deliberately, because a wrong post under somebody's name cannot be undone.
- **AI is metered, not bring-your-own-key-only.** It runs on the house key within a monthly allowance;
  supplying your own OpenAI or Anthropic key removes the limit on every plan, including Free.
- **There is no QR download button.** The code is an SVG regenerated from the link each time it is shown.
- **There is no share modal and no native OS share sheet.**
- **The utility tools are a directory of links to a separate site**, not tools that run inside Trizlink.
- **The public API is on Pro and Team.** A Free account can create zero API keys.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.trizlink.com/intro): What Trizlink is, who it is for, and which parts are live.
- [Create your account](https://docs.trizlink.com/getting-started/create-account): Google-only sign-in and your first workspace.
- [Quick Start](https://docs.trizlink.com/getting-started/quick-start): Your first short link and bio page.

## Features

- [Short links](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/short-links): Custom codes, passwords, expiry, targeting, A/B splits, and the 301/302/200 redirect rules.
- [Bio pages](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/link-in-bio): Three layouts, fifteen block types, and a public slug.
- [QR codes](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/qr-codes): Derived from the link, four error-correction levels, scans counted separately.
- [Analytics](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/analytics): Clicks over time by country, referrer, device and browser — with no IP address stored.
- [Custom domains](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/custom-domains): Adding and verifying a domain, and what is not live yet.
- [Link organization](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/link-organization): One label per link, folders, collections, and CSV import.
- [Tracking & UTM](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/tracking-and-utm): UTM templates, tracking pixels, and ten webhook events.
- [Workspaces & teams](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/workspaces-and-teams): Four fixed roles; teams and the audit log are Team-plan.
- [Social media](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/social-media): Connecting accounts and composing posts, and why nothing publishes yet.
- [Widgets](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/widgets): Embed a link list, a collection or a bio page on any site.
- [AI features](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/ai-features-byok): Three text panels, metered on the house key, unmetered with your own.
- [API access](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/api-access): 18 endpoints, eight scopes, separate destructive permissions.
- [Utility tools](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/utility-tools): A directory of links to a separate free tools site.
- [Browser extension](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/browser-extension): There is none — what to use instead.
- [Theme customizer](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/theme-customizer): Ten axes in one control, applied before first paint.
- [Sharing](https://docs.trizlink.com/features/sharing): How a link travels, and what the product does not do here.

## Guides

- [FAQ](https://docs.trizlink.com/guides/faq): Accounts, pricing, privacy, limits, and the honest answers to what is missing.

## About

- [Privacy & data](https://docs.trizlink.com/about/privacy-and-data): No IP stored, a salted visitor hash, and how to delete everything.
- [Changelog](https://docs.trizlink.com/about/changelog): Product and documentation history, including the 2.13.0 rebuild and its data reset.
- [About the author](https://docs.trizlink.com/about/about-the-author): Ahsan Mahmood, the developer behind Trizlink.
